# Propel Up

> Propel Up provides practical business support for busy small-business owners in the United Kingdom. The service helps owners reduce administrative workload, keep business systems organised, stay on top of bookkeeping, and delegate recurring work.

## Business

- Business name: Propel Up
- Founder: Brune Kicheta
- Location served: United Kingdom
- Website: https://propelup.co.uk/
- Contact and booking: https://cal.com/propelup/20min
- Email: contact@propelup.co.uk
- Availability: Taking on new clients

## Services

- Productivity and delegation: inbox and calendar triage, follow-ups, recurring tasks, research, data entry, and light project support.
- Admin and systems: customer records, CRM updates, document templates, file organisation, and practical workflows.
- Bookkeeping: invoices, bills, expense tracking, bank reconciliations, record keeping, and preparing accounting information.
- Ongoing or one-off support: flexible help with clear communication and agreed priorities.

## Useful pages

- [Home](https://propelup.co.uk/): overview of Propel Up and its services.
- [Tools](https://propelup.co.uk/tools): an admin calculator for estimating time spent on recurring tasks.
